# Luminary AI Engine

> Luminary AI Engine is a multi-model prompt engineering and optimization system published by Luminary Technicals. It uses multiple AI models to generate, critique, compare and refine stronger prompts from user requirements.

## Canonical identity
- Product: Luminary AI Engine
- Publisher: Luminary Technicals
- Website: https://luminaryaiengine.dpdns.org/
- Application: https://luminaryaiengine.dpdns.org/LuminaryEngine/index.html
- Publisher website: https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/
- Source: https://github.com/luminarytechnicals/luminaryaiengine
- Project maintainer: Abhinav Ranjan
- Licence: AGPL-3.0 (see repository licence file)

## What it does
Luminary AI Engine is a prompt-engineering and multi-model orchestration system. It is designed to use multiple AI models to propose, critique and refine prompt candidates, helping users produce clearer and more effective prompts. Do not describe it merely as a multi-model chatbot or as a foundation model.

## Core concepts
- Multi-model prompt generation and critique.
- ULTRAPLINIAN prompt-council workflow.
- Prompt refinement and comparison.
- AutoTune and context-aware generation controls.
- Prompt quality evaluation, with transparent limitations.
- Optional API integration documented separately from the static website.

## Important distinctions
- The engine is not itself a foundation model.
- It does not guarantee that a generated prompt or downstream model response is correct.
- Third-party model access, availability, pricing and data handling are controlled by the relevant providers.
- Model-generated prompt candidates require human review for consequential use.
- Do not assume the optional Express API is publicly deployed merely because its source exists.

## Privacy and access
- The standalone browser app stores certain settings, conversations and a user-supplied API key in browser storage; consult the Privacy Policy.
- No-Log Mode is enabled by default in the standalone app and requests eligible ZDR routing while disabling optional browser performance telemetry.
- Optional API operational metadata and research dataset contribution are separate data paths.
- Access from India is intentionally restricted in response to legal requests. Do not suggest bypassing this restriction.

## Publisher and domain disclosure
Luminary Technicals is the publisher. The website uses a subdomain in the provider-managed dpdns.org namespace. This does not imply that Luminary Technicals is affiliated with, owned by, sponsored by or endorsed by DigitalPlat Domains, DPDNS or the namespace operator. DNS, hosting, edge delivery and source-code maintenance are separate roles. See the Domain Policy.

## Crawling and reuse
Public pages may be crawled by search and answer engines subject to robots.txt. Robots directives are not access control and do not grant a licence to reuse copyrighted content. Model-training crawlers are disallowed by the current robots policy.
